label: Gloves tier list, Act 1

items.verdict: catch-all for non-magical gloves; purely cosmetic, no effect at all
+1 strength saves is barely a bonus; that save is almost never targeted
only for summoners who pick mindless summons that ignore the madness downside
best in slot for defensive monks and shield-less casters; +2 AC arrives early
best act-one gloves for warlocks; +1 spell attack and no melee disadvantage
free jump on dash is nice mobility but a waste of a potent glove slot
best in slot for any ranged attacker; flat +2 damage plus bow proficiency
bugged into a free Bane on hit; strong if you build party around saves
key for reverberation builds, though Luminous Gloves often compete for the slot
first unarmed damage boost; 1d4 fire on every strike makes it monk best in slot
best item in the game; sets Dex 18, frees a feat and a pile of stat points
free 1d10 AoE once per short rest; fine but nothing to get excited about
temp HP and fear immunity off channel oath; most paladins want better gloves
blocks one arrow a turn; duplicated by shield spell and Bracers of Defence
+1 sleight of hand stays relevant all game if swapped in for skill checks
advantage when surrounded is powerful but the positioning work is punishing
advantage on sleight of hand; functionally equivalent to the Gloves of Power
best act-one damage gloves for a thrown-weapon character; +1d4 per throw
blade ward on any heal, even thrown potions; free party-wide damage resistance
rewards ending rage early, which no barbarian ever wants to do
lightning charges for non-Tavern-Brawler monks until Cinder and Sizzle arrives
cold damage is too scarce in act one and enemies pass the freeze save anyway
+1 AC for anyone plus an extra bardic inspiration; best in slot for most bards

unassigned.why: Herbalist's Gloves are discussed and dismissed ('safe to get rid of at the earliest opportunity') but the narrator never speaks a letter, so no tier is recorded; this entry is not a verdict, so items+unassigned is 24 against 23 spoken verdicts

count_note: Off by +1: Herbalist's Gloves are dismissed at 39:37 without a letter being spoken, so the row is unassigned rather than a verdict.
